'''G0-A1''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the fighting in [[Section X]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during the [[Galactic War]], G0-A1 was sent by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Avrun]] back to [[Crag Outpost]] for aid.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
G0-A1 appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the Imperial courier for the HK-51 missions, which were added in Game Update 1.5: HK-51 Activated.<ref name="TOR" />
